DIRECTOR, FOOTWEAR STANDARDS ENGINEERING, NIKE (VIETNAM/INDONESIA)


WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

 

This role reports to the Senior Director, Footwear & Materials Costing, serves on the global Footwear Costing leadership team, and leads a distributed Standards Engineering team. They partner across Analytics, Engineering, Costing, Product Creation, Finance, Sourcing, and Footwear Manufacturing Partners to advance standards and manufacturing competitiveness.

 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR


We are looking for a future-facing people leader who combines industrial engineering and manufacturing expertise with strong analytical judgment to lead Nike’s Standards Engineering team. This leader brings deep knowledge of work measurement, labor standards, manufacturing, and product costing, while embracing data, automation, artificial intelligence, and statistical methods to strengthen how standards are created, governed, evolved, and applied. They can move confidently between technical detail and enterprise-level implications, establish a clear fact base, and translate complex information into actionable business recommendations. They lead with curiosity, accountability, and care, developing talent across countries while building strong partnerships with senior leaders and manufacturing partners. Equally comfortable setting global strategy and challenging established methodologies, they bring pragmatic problem-solving, strong communication, and the ability to turn engineering and costing concepts into measurable business value.

 

  • Open to candidates based in Vietnam or Indonesia.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Data Science, Business, Operations, Supply Chain, or related field.
  • 8+ years of relevant experience in industrial engineering, manufacturing, labor standards, product costing, operations analytics, or related disciplines, including demonstrated people leadership.
  • Deep knowledge of footwear construction, manufacturing, innovation, costing, work measurement, labor-standard methods, statistical analysis, and data-based decision-making; footwear supply chain experience strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of analytics, automation, and artificial intelligence-enabled workflows is expected. Experience with predetermined motion time systems, JMP or comparable statistical software, Power BI, and product-costing systems is preferred.

 

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON


You will lead the Footwear Standards Engineering team, shaping the next evolution of competitive, sustainable costing standards and best practices. You’ll own strategy, governance, and the annual operating rhythm for labor and process standards while modernizing the function through engineering, data, artificial intelligence, automation, and analytics.
